steps.text: Your hatred for dried blood will cause your spearhead to rust and go dull.
Tonight will be the same as that night. There will be but a single moon in the lake.
The reflection of the moonlight, weak and powerless, always hiding in the back... If only things had gone in a different direction...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Ah... It's too quiet.
The calmest nights are always the cruelest, for that is when those who should not have been forgotten are dragged to the surface of our memories.
You must remember... I told you this before. We often rested at the campsite by the lake, sat around the campfire, and discussed how to deal with the beasts.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The crackling, the turning barbecue, the melting fat. I remember.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I... I will never forget any of it.
It's time. Let's not keep the beast waiting any longer.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hm? A fire from that direction...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The abandoned camp?!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Who could be there?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Someone cooked here...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: This fire...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The Terran night sky looks just about the same as ours... but the stars apurr to be in completely different pawsitions.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow... So meowny strange clouds covering the sky tonight, like nothing I've ever seen. I should note this down.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: From what Noir Corne has told me, Terra's climate is not meowch different from ours.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Wind, thunderstorms, rain, and snow... Similar environments have similar natural cycles. Nothing strange about that.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But he also mentioned a phenomeownon called... Catastrophes? What could be so cat-astrophic to deserve a name like that?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: If his description is accurate, then they're as terrifying and destructive as the Amatsu turning out, only caused by this Originium they seem so obsessed with...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: How could rocks pawssibly be the cause of anything when they can't even move? I can't make heads or tails of how this works.

spans.text: How could rocks pawssibly be the cause of
anything
when they can't even move? I can't make heads or tails of how this works.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Not that I'm one to acknowledge a phenomeownon I've never observed myself, but... it seems nearly everything unique about Terra has to do with Originium.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Oh... If only I could see a Catastrophe with meow own eyes...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mrow? Is Noir Corne back?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Huh? Who's that...?

a.text: The fire illuminates the elderly man's face.

spans.text: The fire illuminates the elderly man's face.

a.text: The ravines, though eroded away by the past...

spans.text: The ravines, though eroded away by the past...

a.text: seem far more ancient than everything he's been through.

spans.text: seem far more ancient than everything he's been through.

a.text: He cannot remember how long ago it was.

spans.text: He cannot remember how long ago it was.

a.text: The campfire before him feels just as hot as it did then.

spans.text: The campfire before him feels just as hot as it did then.

a.text: Time once burnt away rouses once again those muddled voices.

spans.text: Time once burnt away rouses once again those muddled voices.

a.text: He cannot tell if it is he or the earth which is shaking...

spans.text: He cannot tell if it is he or the earth which is shaking...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Akira...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Akira.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Hah, you're not dead yet, old timer.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Indeed, not yet.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Unlike you, these fierce but dull-witted beasts will never defeat me.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Life is stubborn, huh? That's what you think? Just like those beasts who keep crawling forward even with their skulls pierced?

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Not bad. You think that's what you've become.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Listen up. I will keep hunting.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: It doesn't matter if there are a hundred, a thousand, or even ten thousand of those beasts in the forest. I won't stop until they're all dead.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: It doesn't matter what I am up against... One by one, I will kill each and every one of them with my own two hands.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I have to hunt the big one now. I have no time to deal with you or your word games.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: *cough*—Scratch marks, and huge ones, too.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: It must've been here not too long ago... It's hungry, and it's on the hunt.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: You don't stand a chance tonight.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Preposterous.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: You're old and battered, and you've just been through a brutal struggle. Plus, it's raining, and there's no one to help you here.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: If you keep going like this, you will die. You're no wild beast. You know that.

spans.text: If you keep going like this, you
will
die. You're no wild beast. You know that.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm not like you... I won't go down so easily.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: You know who you are.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: ...Look at these fallen leaves. If I cover these marks with them, no one will know they weren't washed here by the rain.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No one else will find its tracks. This hunt is mine and mine alone.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Really, old timer, sometimes I don't get what the point of all this is.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: So now you're going to criticize me?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: All I did was take your place and do what you would.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Really now?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Chasing beasts into the forest like it's the end of the world... hacking and slashing at them, carving out their hearts, and coming home covered in cuts and bruises...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You used to blabber about hunting day in and day out. Isn't that what you loved the most?

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Even after all this time, you still don't understand me.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Oh? I don't understand you? Then what about you? Do you think you all your actions were correct?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You've never once listened to what I say. Have you ever tried to understand how I feel? Even once?

spans.text: You've never once listened to what I say. Have you ever tried to understand how
I
feel? Even once?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That night, if you had listened to even a single word I said...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: If you hadn't charged into this damnable forest, you wouldn't have turned into an unrecognizable pile of minced meat.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: And I would never have left you behind like those guys did.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Do you still not understand? Everything that I do... I'm doing it for you.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: No, Yoshitaka, you're doing it for yourself.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: And you know it.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: He can't hear your voice.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We meet again, Kashiwau.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: So that was you...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I warned you not to enter the forest.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We're free to come and go as we please. We have no reason to be intimidated by you.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You stubborn kids don't know what's good for you... You don't know what real fear is!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You will die! Do you get it? Die!

spans.text: You will
die
! Do you get it? Die!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Maybe. But more importantly, nothing can scare us off from completing our mission.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And may I ask you to set down what you're holding?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: This is my hunting equipment... Mine, you thieves!

spans.text: This is
my
hunting equipment... Mine, you thieves!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Feel free to take what's yours, but please put down the things that belong to us.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You won't need them, and that's because you're leaving this forest right this instant! Don't even think about getting in my way!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Preposterous.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Alright, I see now... You're just here to make trouble for me, aren't you? You want to take everything from me, don't you? Just like them.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You're overthinking this. I'm only worried about your safety.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You see, Kashiwau, you came here too. Which means we share the same objective.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I don't understand why you feel the way you do, and naturally I don't need to know either.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But I have a suggestion. Let's set aside our differences and work together. We can solve a lot of problems that way.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Not a chance! That quarry is mine and nobody else's!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: In that case, I ask only that you not interfere with our work anymore.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Furthermore, considering we have the same objective, your actions will likely affect us one way or another...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So I suggest you wait at the camp until daybreak. You're free to return to the village after that.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, that's a bit...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You... How dare you!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Begone! Crawl back to wherever you came from!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I refuse.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hold on, you two.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I... I'll have the lot of you...

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: I see it!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy, what do you see?
Hunters! You need to leave this place and put out that campfire immediately!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: That voice... You're...!
The firelight has attracted the Rathalos's attention. It'll come attacking any second now!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The Rathalos?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Rathalos!
